name: SeaweedFS

evidence.files: C02: self-hosted file and object storage is the primary type; F05: S3 API for common object operations

line: Distributed S3-compatible storage that you run on your own servers.

free.text: Apache-2.0; no community quota or hosted idle rule; you control disks/retention

cells.regions: You place servers and choose fault domains

sql.math: SeaweedFS stores files and objects, not databases
SeaweedFS stores files and objects, not databases

files.math: The Apache-2.0 license costs $0 (a free open-source license). 100 GB of disks, servers, power and network depend on your setup.

jobs.math: SeaweedFS does not run background jobs
